The duo, who has released four albums and two EPs, has connected with the world by performing at great festivals and venues in more than 30 countries. They continue their venues in more than 30 countries. performances as part of the Echo Drama Tour.<br />Ductape invites listeners to dance over their disappointments with their interpretation of 80's Post-Punk.</p></div></div></div></div><div class='overview-event'><div class='overview-day-time'>Sa - 21:00 Uhr</div><div class='overview-day'>26/09.2026</div><div class='overview-name'><a href='#' class='wk_touch showdetails' id='event_2124'>Pure Darkness - Die Gothic-Wave-Dark-Elektro-Nacht</a></div><div class='detailswrapper displaynone event_2124'><div class='overviewdetails-content content_event_2124'><div class='overview-img lazyload'><a href='687967328-1409989671165627-4139016697373144464-n.jpg' class='swipebox' title='26.09.2026 Pure Darkness - Die Gothic-Wave-Dark-Elektro-Nacht'><img src='images/blank.gif' class='lazy lazytoload upimg-wide' alt='Die Stadtmitte#687967328-1409989671165627-4139016697373144464-n.jpg' /></a></div><div><p>Wenn die Schatten l&auml;nger werden und die Nacht ihren Atem anh&auml;lt, &ouml;ffnet sich im Club DIE-STADTMITTE Karlsruhe das Tor zu einer anderen Welt:<br /> <br />Pure Darkness.
